spec_match.rationale: A real AudioWorkletProcessor renders a sine with genuine synthetic DSP load per process() call and reports deadline overruns measured inside the worklet (render time vs block budget) — the exact failure mode a larger quantum mitigates.

interactive.rationale: Hint segmented buttons restart the context live, the load slider posts real load values into the worklet, start/stop control the session, and the health grid plus scope update continuously.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card's promise matches the page's verified behaviour.

edge_cases.rationale: This refile replaced the v151 alert() error path with a visible status line, and the quantum readout distinguishes '(not exposed)' from a real value with an explanatory sentence; the deadline counters are worklet-measured either way.

references.rationale: See-also now includes the ChromeStatus entry (added in this refile) plus the spec.

conformance.rationale: The new v153 feature suite ran in the verification browser at 5 pass / 4 fail / 0 blocked — the 4 fails are the shipped-attribute assertions, the honest 'not yet shipped' answer on Chromium 141 (anticipated Chrome 153), exactly as their descriptions state.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP page-driver run (headless Chromium 141 with autoplay permitted): started with honest not-exposed status line, real heartbeats accumulated (good blocks 36 then 72), load slider pushed to 400 live, cps updated, stop cleanly returned; console/network clean; screenshot v153-rq-glitch.png read. Headless null-sink rendering is fast, so no deadline misses occurred in this environment.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts rq-stress-started with hint and quantum readout and rq-stress-context-failed on the constructor error path.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons that override background also override color; small-text emerald readouts darkened via color-mix to meet AA.

accessibility.rationale: Status line is role=status aria-live=polite; the load slider has an aria-label and a visible numeric readout; health stats are text; scope canvas has an aria-label.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check v153/webaudio-configurable-render-quantum --no-server: desktop OK clean, mobile OK (sub-44px flags are inline links, primary buttons/sliders remain usable); both screenshots read and judged clean.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify on a build where the Chrome 153 flip has landed
openQuestions.detail: The verification browser (Chromium 141, no origin trial) does not expose renderQuantumSize, so every hint is honestly reported as ignored. Once a Chrome 153 stable (or a build launched with --enable-blink-features=WebAudioConfigurableRenderQuantum) is available, re-run the page and confirm the quantum readouts flip to real values and the four not-yet conformance assertions pass.

openQuestions.title: Observe a real missed deadline on constrained hardware
openQuestions.detail: In headless Chromium the null audio sink renders faster than realtime, so even load 400 produced zero missed deadlines. On real hardware, verify the missed-deadline counter rises under load and drops when switching to a larger quantum once the hint is honoured.
